text:
micah: Heads up — Q3 product launch projections show a ~3x spike in embeddings + rerank traffic for the launch window. Need a quick capacity/forecast: realtime embeddings pool vs separate batch rerank/backfill pools. Also factor EU region constraints and our Dedicated caps.

anita: Do we have traffic shape (hourly profile) and current realtime vs batch split? Any hard SLA for rerank?

ryan: From sampling last week: embeddings ~65% realtime, rerank ~70% realtime during peak search flows. The launch adds an analytics backfill window that is mostly batch and hits at 02:00-05:00 UTC.

sofia: If embeddings realtime triples, our low-latency g5 pool will be saturated. Rough back-of-envelope: current = ~1.2k GPU-hours/mo, spike -> ~3.6k. Need model-specific throughput to refine.

jules: Recommend: 1) separate low-latency small pool (p95 <60ms) for embeddings, 2) separate high-throughput batch pool for rerank/backfills, 3) autoscale + pre-warm for the realtime pool before the launch.

infra-bot: Autoscale policy 'emb-lowlat' scheduled scale up at 2026-07-15T03:00Z.

micah: Can someone run a per-model gpu-hours estimate. Quick SQL we use as a baseline:

```
SELECT SUM(tokens) / ({{tokens_per_sec}} * 3600) AS gpu_hours
FROM usage_events
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '{{start}}' AND '{{end}}'
GROUP BY model_name;
```

ryan: I'll run that per-model. Note: tokens_per_sec varies a lot by quantization & model size — use 40 t/s for small quantized encoders, ~180 t/s for fp16 Llama2-like. I'll split by model and quant.

anita: Also callout: EU -> us-west cross-region reroutes for rerank increase egress costs and add latency. Prefer a local eu batch pool for analytics backfill to avoid egress spikes.

sofia: Tradeoffs: batch pool with bigger batch sizes reduces GPU-hours but needs time windows. Must ensure priority rules so batch backfills don't evict realtime. Preemption + QoS needed.

micah: Action items: Ryan — run per-model gpu-hours + cost delta (realtime vs batch). Anita — prototype EU-local batch pool costs and sizing. Jules — draft autoscale + pre-warm configs and SLO targets. Can we get numbers by EOD tomorrow? @ryan @anita @jules

ryan: On it, ETA EOD tomorrow.

jules: I'll draft the autoscale policy and a short pre-warm runbook, then drop the link here. Placeholder: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-capacity

micah: Thanks. Please include 95th and 99th percentile scenarios and compare burn on committed Dedicated capacity vs on-demand. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Thread will be archived to 'capacity-sprints' after 7d of inactivity.
